interpretation.plain_speak: When Wingless cannot save everything, spending the next action on the dependency with the shortest time-to-failure matters. With the same 12 actions, countdown scheduling prevents 11 failures per scenario; fixed-order prevents only 4.
interpretation.north_star_question: Moves bounded self-maintenance from 'does a corrective action work?' to 'can native risk state allocate scarce corrective capacity intelligently?' The answer is positive in this frozen counterfactual regime.
interpretation.next_stage: replicate countdown-guided global allocation across several action budgets and permuted arm indices to verify the advantage is not tied to one budget or fixed tie/order structure
